purpose: Reviewed named-provider daily backup implementation scope. Official documentation is design evidence, not observed resource protection, pinned wire-contract coverage or live certification. Unsupported means the current Hypervibe adapter has no daily policy path; native provider capabilities are described separately.

resources.reason: Policy observation and additive configuration adapter implemented; no live certification or recovery-point inventory.
resources.nativeCapability: DAILY is every 24 hours; can coexist with WEEKLY and MONTHLY
limitations: Mutation acknowledgement is not convergence
Missing retentionSeconds is unknown observed retention, not proof of six days
A manual snapshot does not establish a schedule
Deleting a volume deletes its native backups

resources.reason: Policy observation and additive configuration adapter implemented; no live certification or recovery-point inventory.
resources.nativeCapability: Standard backup option is daily; Enhanced Backup and DR plans are a different control plane
limitations: Legacy Hypervibe policy currently always enables daily plus PITR; preserve that exact meaning when migrating old specs
Do not treat Enhanced Backup and DR state as an absent standard policy
Policy configuration alone is not a usable backup or tested restore

resources.reason: Daily policy observation/configuration is not implemented in this Hypervibe adapter.
resources.nativeCapability: Automatic daily backups on eligible paid projects while PITR is disabled
limitations: Free tier does not supply this automatic daily guarantee
Database backups do not include Storage API objects
Deleting a project deletes its backups

resources.reason: Daily policy observation/configuration is not implemented in this Hypervibe adapter.

limitations: Changing retention between zero and nonzero can cause an outage
Stopped instances do not create backups
RDS instance and Multi-AZ DB-cluster contracts differ; current adapter uses DB instances

resources.reason: Daily policy observation/configuration is not implemented in this Hypervibe adapter.
resources.nativeCapability: Automatic daily snapshot backups; suspended while no data changes, with a new backup immediately after changes resume
limitations: Do not promise a newly created physical snapshot every 24 hours for an idle database
Daily backup policy does not establish application restore compatibility

resources.reason: Daily policy observation/configuration is not implemented in this Hypervibe adapter.

retentionEvidence.note: Exact scheduled snapshot retention fields/defaults not established in this bounded review; must pin the full official operation schema before implementation

Do not infer retention from project history retention
Do not silently change plan or authorize cost

limitations: Deleting the cluster deletes its backups
Do not substitute Droplet backup policy for managed database policy

resources.reason: Exact bound-volume policy observation and additive configuration adapter implemented; no live certification or recovery-point inventory.
resources.nativeCapability: Native manual and scheduled daily/weekly/monthly volume backups. Daily every 24 hours retained 6 days; weekly 27 days; monthly 89 days.
limitations: Volume wiping removes its backups.
Restore stays within the same project and environment.
Manual backup size limit is 50% of volume capacity.
Native snapshot is not an independent offsite copy.

resources.reason: Current lifecycle does not observe/converge automatic snapshot settings or latest completed snapshot.
resources.nativeCapability: Automatic daily snapshots default on; default retention 5 days, configurable from 1 to 60 days. Restore creates a new volume.
limitations: Changing retention affects new snapshots.
Native snapshots leave a data-loss window since the latest snapshot.
Snapshot presence does not prove application consistency.

resources.reason: Add backing-filesystem backup observation/convergence and recovery-point receipts.
resources.nativeCapability: AWS Backup supports EFS scheduling, retention, full/item restore. Default EFS automatic backup plan is daily with 35-day retention.
limitations: API/CLI creation defaults backups on only for One Zone; Hypervibe creates regional EFS, so creation success is not evidence of backup enablement.
Custom vault/plan IAM and charges need reviewed actions.

resources.reason: No Filestore backup schedule, backup inventory, or retention lifecycle currently exists.
resources.nativeCapability: Basic Filestore supports standard differential backups. Standard backups have no native scheduling or expiry. Official automation uses Cloud Scheduler and Cloud Run functions. Enhanced Backup and DR scheduling supports Zonal/Regional/Enterprise, not Basic.
limitations: Standard backup survives source share deletion but not source-project deletion.
Cross-region storage is supported.
Application-consistent backup requires stopping writers and unmounting according to official guidance.
Enhanced support/access must be checked per region and tier.

resources.reason: No Recovery Services backup policy/protection registration or latest backup observation is implemented.
resources.nativeCapability: Azure Backup supports scheduled Azure Files snapshots and vaulted backups; custom daily retention. Vaulted backup transfers the last daily snapshot into a Recovery Services vault.
limitations: Azure Backup Files support is SMB, not NFS.
Snapshot-only backups stay in the source storage account.
Vault tier and regional support must be verified.
Snapshot retention/count limits differ from vaulted retention.

resources.reason: No provider persistent-mount backup target exists for this adapter.
resources.nativeCapability: App Platform local filesystems are ephemeral and persistent volumes are unsupported.
limitations: Do not imply App Platform local writes survive deployment.
DigitalOcean Spaces is mentioned by provider docs but is not a named Hypervibe storage adapter in this inventory.

resources.reason: No persistent-mount backup target for this adapter.
resources.nativeCapability: Vercel Functions do not expose a persistent writable filesystem.
limitations: Temporary scratch space is not a recoverable persistent mount.
Vercel Blob is not a named Hypervibe storage adapter in this inventory.

resources.reason: No retained backup destination, schedule, integrity manifest, retention or restore lifecycle.
resources.nativeCapability: List/get/put/copy object operations exist. Object versioning, object locks and bucket lifecycle configuration are explicitly unsupported. Bucket instances and credentials are environment-scoped.
limitations: No native scheduled bucket-backup contract established by reviewed documentation.
Same-project second bucket remains in a shared administrative failure domain.
A replacement/deletion-propagating mirror is not retained history.

resources.reason: No AWS Backup planner, vault selection, policy association or backup status in storage adapter.
resources.nativeCapability: AWS Backup supports periodic daily S3 recovery points in a backup vault, with configured retention and cross-account/region copies. S3 versioning is a prerequisite; source versioning itself keeps versions within the same bucket.
limitations: General-purpose buckets only; unsupported storage classes must be reported.
Continuous backup requires EventBridge configuration; periodic is separate.
Do not overwrite unrelated bucket notification settings.
Versioning alone is not an independent copy.

resources.reason: No retained object recovery-set schedule/status/restore lifecycle.
resources.nativeCapability: Storage Transfer Service supports daily scheduled bucket copies. Versioning preserves noncurrent objects in the same bucket; soft delete/locks are protection, and replication is redundancy.
limitations: A continuously overwritten destination does not establish daily historical restore points.
Versioning or soft delete in the source is not independent backup.
No native bucket-backup-vault contract was established in reviewed docs; do not confuse VM Backup and DR with backup of GCS buckets.

resources.reason: No Data Protection backup vault/policy/protected instance planner or recovery-point observation.
resources.nativeCapability: Azure Blob vaulted backup supports daily or weekly scheduled recovery points and retention policy. Operational backup is continuous local protection and does not place a separate copy in the vault.
limitations: Account/blob type and region must meet provider support matrix.
Vaulted restore targets a different storage account.
Source versioning/soft delete alone does not establish independent recovery storage.
